scenes.narration: Volcanoes are openings in the Earth where molten rock, called magma, rises from deep inside our planet.
scenes.prompt: A cross-section of the Earth showing crust, mantle, and a glowing magma chamber beneath, with simple 2D illustration style, vibrant colors, educational infographic

scenes.narration: Magma forms when rocks melt due to intense heat and pressure deep underground. As it rises through cracks in the crust, it pushes against surrounding rock.
scenes.prompt: A vertical slice of Earth's crust with a fissure showing glowing orange magma moving upward, simple 2D style, clear visual flow

scenes.narration: When pressure builds enough, an eruption occurs. Magma bursts through the surface as lava, ash, and gas, creating dramatic plumes that can reach high into the atmosphere.
scenes.prompt: A volcanic cone erupting with a fountain of bright orange lava and gray ash cloud rising upward, realistic but stylized for 2D animation

scenes.narration: After cooling, hardened lava forms new rock layers on Earth's surface. Over time, repeated eruptions build up mountains and reshape landscapes.
scenes.prompt: A newly formed volcanic landscape with dark basalt flows solidifying into jagged ridges, a calm scene showing the cooled crust overlying fresh lava
